es.example: Diste en el clavo con esa respuesta.
es.exampleTranslation: You hit the nail on the head with that answer.

it.example: Hai colto nel segno con la tua analisi.
it.exampleTranslation: You hit the mark with your analysis.

bridge.note: Spanish uses the nail, as English does; Italian aims at a target (segno). cogliere is a high-value B1 verb, the same one that takes an opportunity as well as a target.

interference.es_to_it: 'Dare nel chiodo' isn't Italian. Italian catches the mark: cogliere nel segno.
interference.it_to_es: 'Coger en el signo' fails twice — it isn't the Spanish idiom, and coger is vulgar in Mexico and the Río de la Plata. Spanish hits the nail: dar en el clavo.
